title: DECSET 2048 — In-band resize notifications
summary: CSI ? 2048 h enables in-band resize notifications: the terminal sends CSI 48 ; rows ; cols t (or CSI 8 ; rows ; cols t for pixels) when the window is resized, instead of (or in addition to) SIGWINCH. CSI ? 2048 l disables it.

frame.note: DEC private modes are CSI sequences with a leading '?' (0x3F) private-parameter prefix. Set = final byte 'h' (DECSET); reset = final byte 'l' (DECRST).

terminator_detail.note: No string terminator: a DEC private mode is a CSI sequence ending at its final byte ('h' to set, 'l' to reset).

params.name: Enable (DECSET)
params.meaning: CSI ? 2048 h In-band resize; CSI 48/8 notifications.

gotchas: In-band resize sends the new dimensions as an escape sequence on the tty, so programs that don't handle SIGWINCH still learn about resizes.
Format: CSI 48 ; rows ; cols t (text cells) or CSI 8 ; rows ; cols t (pixels).
Useful for programs running over SSH or in containers where SIGWINCH may not propagate.
Supported by kitty, WezTerm, and others.

v1_smoke_test.asserts: DECSET/DECRST 2048 render as byte-exact CSI ? 2048 h/l sequences.
